Create a ZIP that you can submit to Remotion if asked for a reproduction.

## CLI flag

Use `--repro` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                               | Flag      |
| ------------------------------------- | --------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio) | `--repro` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render) | `--repro` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#repro)
